body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Currently amended) A breath sampler (100) for collecting a breath sample from a patient, the breath sampler comprising:
a non-rebreather part (110) comprising:
a sample inlet (130);
a one-way outlet valve (160) arranged to allow air to exit the non-rebreather part (110), the one-way outlet valve (160) and the sample inlet (130) defining a first portion of an internal breath flow pathway therebetween; and
an air inlet (110) arranged to be closed by a one-way inlet valve arranged to allow air to enter the non-rebreather part (110), the air inlet (140) being in fluid communication with the first portion of the internal breath flow pathway; and
a sample delivery part (120) in fluid communication with the non-rebreather part (110) at an upstream end via the one-way outlet valve (160), the sample delivery part defining a second portion of the internal breath flow pathway, the sample delivery part (120) comprising:
an air diverter (170), in the sample delivery part (120), arranged to divide the sample delivery part (120) into an upstream portion and a downstream portion;
a sample outlet (190) in the upstream portion;
a return inlet (195) in the downstream portion and in fluid communication with an exhaust (180); and
a sample collection chamber connector (150) configured to form a seal with an opening of a sample collection chamber (200), the connector defining a perimeter (P), the sample outlet (190) and the return inlet (195) being disposed within the perimeter (P);
wherein the breath sampler (100) further comprises the sample collection chamber (200) coupled to the sample collection chamber connector (150), the sample collection chamber (200) comprising a liquid capture interface (310),
wherein the breath sampler (100) is configured so that, during operation, the breath from the patient passes through the non-rebreather part (110), is delivered via the sample delivery part (120) to the sample outlet (190) into the sample collection chamber (200), passes through the liquid capture interface (310) in the sample collection chambers (200) which captures at least one of chemical markers and biological markers from the breath sample, the breath then re-enters the sample delivery part (120) from the sample collection chamber (200) via the return inlet (195), and escapes the breath sampler (100) via the exhaust (180).
2. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 1, further comprising a sample delivery tube (300) coupled to the sample outlet (190) for delivering the breath sample to the liquid capture interface (310), and wherein the sample delivery tube is removably connected to the sample outlet.
3. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 2, further comprising a diffuser (1120) coupled to the sample delivery tube (300), the diffuser (1120) comprising an inlet and a network of channels to divide the breath sample from the inlet into a plurality of streams.
4. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, wherein the air diverter (170) comprises a wall extending in a plane that is transverse to the longitudinal axis of the sample delivery part (120).
5. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, further comprising a volumetric breath quantifier (1000) configured to measure a volume of breath delivered to the sample outlet (190).
6. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 5, wherein the volumetric breath quantifier (1000) is configured to separate the breath sample into at least two sub-samples.
7. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 6, wherein the volumetric breath sampler (1000) further comprises a closure member configured to selectively close the sample outlet to prevent a first sub-sample being delivered to the sample collection chamber (200).
8. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 7, wherein the volumetric breath quantifier (1000) comprises a Geneva gear (1018) configured to open the closure member when a predetermined volume of breath has entered the volumetric breath quantifier (1000).
9. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 8, wherein the volumetric breath quantifier (1000) is positioned downstream of the outlet valve (190) and comprises:
a turnstile (1010) rotatably mounted within the breath flow pathway and comprising at least one fin configured to be rotatably displaced by a defined breath volume;
a geared coupling between the turnstile (1010) and the Geneva gear (1018);
wherein the turnstile (1010) is configured to move the Geneva gear (1018) from a first position to a second position, and
wherein movement of the Geneva gear (1018) from the first position to the second position is configured to open the closure member (e.g. a binary valve) to allow a second sub-sample to be delivered to the sample collection chamber (200).
10. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, further comprising a plurality of selectively connectable modules.
11. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 10, wherein:
a first module comprises the non-rebreather part (110), the one-way outlet valve (160) and the one-way air inlet (140); and
a second module comprises the sample delivery part (120) and the sample collection chamber connector (150).
12. (Cancelled)
13. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, further comprising a delivery port (510) in fluid communication with the non- rebreather part (110), configured for connection to a nebuliser (520).
14. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, wherein the sample collection chamber (200) further comprises an integrated testing module (1100).
15. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 14, wherein the integrated testing module (1100) is a lab-on-chip device.
16. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 14 or claim 15, wherein the integrated testing module (1100) comprises a PCR unit.
17. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, wherein at least one of the non-rebreather part (110) and the sample delivery part (120) comprises a sensor configured to measure additional biomarkers, e.g. including one or more of: nucleic acids, cytokines, chemokines, C- reactive protein, hosts and/of pathogens.
18. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, wherein the exhaust (180) comprises a filter or mesh (e.g. a bacterial filter).
19. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to any one of the preceding claimsclaim 1, further comprising a breath sampler cap configured to removably attach to a distal end of the breath sampler (100), the distal end of the breath sampler (100) being an end opposite to an end comprising the sample inlet (130).
20. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 19, wherein the sampler cap is arranged to cover the exhaust (180).
21. (Currently amended) The breath sampler (100) according to claim 19, wherein the sampler cap comprises connection means corresponding to the sample collection chamber (200).
